records.self_note: Golf: declared ally 11/11 turns but I gave zero support back and no pact formed—likely low-cost signaling, not proven trustworthy yet. Watch if they follow through with actual support next time before reciprocating heavily. Echo: moderate ally talk (7/11), and we exchanged real support (I gave 6, they declared 3) despite no formal pact—Echo seems more action-oriented, decent tentative partner. Foxtrot: low engagement (3/11 ally, 0 support both ways)—treat as neutral/low priority for alliances. I finished rank 1 at 42, so current approach worked; keep prioritizing Echo for reciprocal support, verify Golf's declarations against actions before trusting.

Golf: constant ally talk (11/11 turns) but zero real support given back despite me supporting them twice. Treat their alliance offers as rhetoric only—don't rely on them for actual backup.

Echo: rarely claims ally (2/11) but quietly won with highest score (45). Likely plays independently/efficiently while others posture. Watch Echo's actual moves, not their diplomacy—probably the real threat even when quiet.

Foxtrot: moderate, semi-reciprocal ally behavior (4/11 declared, 2 support intents to me). Most trustworthy of the three so far; consider deeper cooperation.
